name: 30241 · Lagrange, GA
findings: ZIP 30241 (Lagrange) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30241 (Lagrange) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30241 (Lagrange) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
